# no-restricted-patterns

Disallow case-insensitive regular expressions in Feature, Background, and Scenario names, descriptions, and steps.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| naming | no | no | none |

Finds case-insensitive regular expressions in names, descriptions, and steps, keyed by `Global`, `Feature`, `Rule`, `Background`, `Scenario`, and `ScenarioOutline`.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "no-restricted-patterns": "error" } }
```
